title: Biased expectation and product mean
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $p\in[0,1]$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The biased expectation polynomial of $f$, evaluated at the bias mean $1-2p$, equals the mean of $f$ under the product distribution on sign vectors whose coordinates have the biased sign distribution with parameter $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
